text:
sophia: heads-up, nightly-inference-e2e (hetero-gpu-pool) went red on PR #4821 — failing warmup on an H100 node with OOM + a weird driver complaint. job: https://ci.redwood.dev/ci/4821/step/warmup :grimacing:
ashok: can you paste the tail of the job log?
sophia: sure, pasted below:
```
[ WARN ] cuda: driver does not match runtime (libcuda: 12.0 vs driver: 12.2)
[ERROR ] KernelLaunch: Xid 13: PTX JIT compilation failed
OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate 24GB
```
manuel: two separate signals — driver mismatch first, then OOM. that often happens when fallback kernels hit slower paths and thrash memory.
lucy: is this reproducible on the canary pool or only hetero-nightly?
sophia: only seen on the hetero-nightly shard so far (node: h100-het-12). CI rerun passed on an a100 node earlier today.
ashok: @infra-bot can you fetch node image + driver versions for h100-het-12?
infra-bot: fetched: node h100-het-12 image=redwood/inference-nightly:2026-03-16, nvidia-driver=535.113, cuda-runtime-lib=12.0. Host driver <-> container runtime mismatch flagged.
manuel: yep, runtime libs in image are 12.0 but host driver is 535 (which maps to CUDA 12.2). that can cause ptx jit fallback. recommend either pinning container runtime to host-compatible libs or upgrade host drivers across pool.
lucy: short-term: can we requeue the job to run on the canary pool (same PR) to see if it's isolated?
sophia: requeueing now to canary. @ci-bot rerun job 4821 on pool=canary-hetero please
ci-bot: acknowledged. queued rerun: https://ci.redwood.dev/ci/4821/rerun/1
ashok: also worth checking GPU memory fragmentation. when OOM happens after PTX failure it might be allocator fragmentation. can we add `--mem-trace` to the warmup flags for the rerun?
sophia: added `--mem-trace` to the canary rerun command.
manuel: if canary passes, we should still schedule a narrow canary of driver update on 2 nodes or patch the image to match runtime libs. risk: cross-pool variability.
lucy: +1 on 2-node canary. @ashok can you coordinate with infra to cordon h100-het-12? we should avoid flaky reruns landing there.
ashok: cordon requested. infra suggests reboot + driver sync during maintenance window tonight. filing infra ticket: INF-872
sophia: if canary rerun still fails, we'll need a bisect matrix: run warmup with (1) image pinned to cuda 12.2 libs, (2) add quantized build toggle, (3) single-thread warmup. any volunteers to drive that?
manuel: I'll own the bisect steps and produce commands. start with reproducer: `./scripts/ci/run_warmup.sh --model=redwood/40b --seq=2048 --mem-trace`.
sophia: thanks. i'll keep the PR blocked until we confirm canary or infra fixes. :thumbsup:
lucy: FYI I've annotated #4821 with the failure summary and linked INF-872.
ashok: ETA for driver sync? infra says 3-4 hours. i'll post updates.
ci-bot: rerun completed on canary: PASS ✅ (warmup OK, no OOM, no ptx errors).
sophia: nice — looks like hetero-het-12 is the culprit. leaving this thread open until INF-872 resolves and we uncordon node.
manuel: once INF-872 done i'll kick the targeted 2-node driver canary and run a couple of warmups. plan posted in INF-872.
sophia: thanks everyone. closing in a bit after infra confirms reboot. :pray:
